basic_profile.bio: Dave is a 28-year-old digital marketing consultant based in New Jersey. He has a keen interest in true crime, particularly unsolved mysteries like the Suzanne Morphew case. Outside of work, Dave is a passionate advocate for medical marijuana and enjoys watching bad movies for a good laugh. Recently, he's taken up collecting sports cards as a hobby and is learning to play the ukulele. Despite being single after a recent breakup, he remains optimistic about the future. Dave usually browses Reddit in the evenings after work, between 7 PM and 11 PM EST.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: Dave has a Bachelor's degree in Marketing and has spent the last five years working freelance in digital marketing. His expertise comes from a combination of formal education and on-the-job experience, with additional self-learning through online courses. He is particularly knowledgeable about SEO and social media strategies.
